key.description: The resource's identity, when that is not its path. Say it when you move the file: the path the resource had. It never changes.

path.description: The resource's path, when the file is kept somewhere that does not give it one.

script.description: The script it starts. Give this or `flow`.

flow.description: The flow it starts, from the flow's manual trigger. Give this or `script`.

input.description: What the script or the flow is given each time.

enabled.description: Whether it fires. Default true. Turn it off to pause it without deleting it.

overlap.description: `skip` passes over a time when the run it started last is still going. Default `allow`.

source.description: A trigger source to hand each request or each tick to first. What it returns is what starts the script or flow.

tags.description: CEL expressions over `trigger`, what the trigger was given. Each gives one tag for the run it starts, such as `'order:' + string(trigger.id)`. A tag is up to 64 characters of a-z, 0-9 and _.:-; an expression that fails or gives anything else is left out.
